tagline: Lawns, very quiet nights, and a car for absolutely everything.
subhead: An apartment tucked among houses and lawns: very quiet, and almost nothing on foot.
scene: You work at home on a street of houses: 73 percent of homes are detached, and 27 percent of workers here also work from home. The evening dog walk follows quiet roads, with a park about 13 minutes on foot. On Saturday you drive to dinner, because only about 3 restaurants and no bars sit within a 10-minute walk. Nearly every household has a car. On Sunday the typical place here is about 72 minutes from your parents by car.
promise: Lawns, quiet streets and a car for everything.
catch: Almost nothing is on foot and the dog park is about 2.7 miles away, so every outing starts in the car. Your parents are about 72 minutes away, and only 9 places of this kind turned up.
host_intro: Let me lower your shoulders for a second. This is an apartment set among houses and lawns, in towns where about 73 percent of homes are detached and nearly every household has a car. You park, you walk the dog on a quiet road, you sleep. The typical place is about 710 square feet, so the desk fits too. If what you want most from your first place is calm, start here. And here is the bill. Almost nothing is on foot, with hardly a restaurant within a 10-minute walk of the typical place and no bars. Choice is thin, only 9 places, at about $2,950 a month all in. Your parents are about 72 minutes away. Going out means going somewhere else.
host_walkthrough:
Weekdays are calm to the point of comedy. The dog gets quiet roads, with a park about 13 minutes on foot and the dog park about 3.7 miles away, which means the car. You work from home among houses and lawns. The supermarket is about 0.5 miles off. Cafés within a 10-minute walk: about 1. Buy a good machine anyway.

Saturday night, you drive. There are about 4 restaurants within 1 mile and no bars within a 10-minute walk, so dinner with friends is a plan and somebody stays sober. The return trip is the reward. Most places here list a garage or covered parking, the street is still, and you are not circling for a spot.

Sunday is a real drive: about 72 minutes to your parents from the typical place, without traffic. Tolls run about $30 round trip with a New York E-ZPass. Transit is about 160 minutes, so call it a car trip. Leave early, stay long, and let them send you home with food.
sub_cost: The typical place sits near the top of your budget.
sub_to_parents: Going home is a trip, so you will choose your Sundays.
sub_going_out: Dinner out starts with the car keys.
sub_green: Lawns everywhere, and a real park takes a drive.
sub_compared_to_queens: You gain space over Queens and give up the walk to dinner.

subhead: More square feet in towns farther out, where nearly everything is a drive.
scene: You work at home with space to spare: the typical place found here is about 750 square feet. The evening dog walk reaches a park in about 10 minutes, on streets where 41 percent of homes are houses. On Saturday you drive out, since about 2 restaurants and no bars are within a 10-minute walk. The supermarket is 0.6 miles away. On Sunday the typical place here is about 67 minutes from your parents by car, or about 110 by transit.
promise: More room for you, your desk and the dog, in towns where many neighbors are families.
catch: Your parents are far, typically about 67 minutes each way. Nearly everything is a drive, including the dog park at about 2.3 miles.
host_intro: You work from home, so let's talk about the room you work in. The typical place here is about 750 square feet, enough for a desk that is not also the dinner table and a dog with the zoomies. All-in runs about $2,600 a month. About 86 percent of the places have a washer in the unit and about 66 percent list a garage or covered spot. It suits you if home is where you spend your days and you want it to feel generous. The trade is everything outside the apartment. About 4 restaurants sit within a 10-minute walk of the typical place and no bars, the dog park is about 2.3 miles away, and your parents are about 67 minutes off, though the closest, Valley Stream, is about 14. You are buying square feet with miles.
host_walkthrough:
A weekday here has elbow room. The desk gets its own corner, the dog gets a park about 10 minutes away, and nobody is working from the couch. Groceries are about 0.8 miles off, so errands mean the car. Most buildings have a gym. The quiet is real, and so is the drive to a decent latte.

Saturday night takes planning. About 10 restaurants sit within 1 mile and bars are scarce, so a night out is a drive there and a sober drive back, or a ride you book ahead. Staying in is the stronger play, because you have the space to host. Friends come to you, and the car stays parked.

Sunday is the long haul. The typical drive to your parents is about 67 minutes each way without traffic, and tolls run about $28 round trip with a New York E-ZPass. The closest, Valley Stream, is about 14 minutes out. Transit is about 110 minutes. Pick your town with this drive in mind.
